How Route Optimization Works

From unassigned jobs to optimized routes in under a minute

1

Select Unassigned Jobs

View all unscheduled jobs on your dashboard. Filter by date, priority, or service type. Select the jobs you want to route for today or this week.

What You'll See:

  • •All pending jobs with customer names and addresses
  • •Service type, duration, and priority level for each job
  • •Filter by date range, service area, or job type
2

Click Create Routes

Hit the Create Routes button. The system analyzes job locations, technician availability, skill requirements, and current traffic conditions.

AI Analyzes:

  • •Geographic proximity of all job locations
  • •Current traffic conditions and predicted delays
  • •Technician skills, availability, and current location
3

Review Optimized Routes

See suggested routes for each technician with total drive time, number of stops, and estimated completion time. Routes are color-coded by tech on the map.

Route Details Include:

  • •Total drive time and miles per technician
  • •Number of stops and estimated completion time
  • •Color-coded routes on map for easy visualization
4

Adjust if Needed

Drag jobs between technicians or reorder stops manually. The system recalculates drive times and ETAs automatically as you make changes.

Easy Adjustments:

  • •Drag-and-drop jobs between technicians
  • •Reorder stops to match customer preferences
  • •System recalculates drive times instantly
5

Send to Technicians

Approve routes and send to technician phones. They get turn-by-turn navigation, job details, and customer info for each stop in order.

Technicians Receive:

  • •Push notification with their daily route
  • •Turn-by-turn navigation for each stop
  • •Customer info and job details at their fingertips
6

Monitor in Real-Time

Watch techs progress throughout the day. See GPS location, current job status, and ETA to next appointment. Adjust routes on the fly if needed.

Live Dashboard Shows:

  • •Real-time GPS location of every technician
  • •Job status (en route, in progress, completed)
  • •Accurate ETAs for customers and next appointments

Powerful Routing Features

Everything you need for intelligent route planning and technician management

🗺️

Real-Time Traffic Integration

Powered by Mapbox, routes automatically adjust for current traffic conditions, accidents, and road closures. Always get the fastest path to every job.

🎯

Skill-Based Auto-Assignment

Automatically assign jobs to technicians based on skill level, certifications, and specialty areas. HVAC jobs go to HVAC techs, plumbing to plumbers.

📍

Geographic Clustering

Group nearby jobs together automatically. Minimize drive time between appointments by clustering jobs in the same neighborhood or zip code.

📡

Live GPS Tracking & ETAs

Watch technicians move in real time. Get accurate ETAs for customers. Know exactly where every tech is and when they will arrive at the next job.

🔄

Dynamic Re-Routing

Job runs late? Emergency call comes in? Routes automatically recalculate to fit new jobs or delays without disrupting the entire schedule.

⚖️

Workload Balancing

Distribute jobs evenly across your team. Prevent one tech from being overwhelmed while another sits idle. Balance by time, distance, and complexity.

⚡

One-Click Route Creation

Select unassigned jobs from your dashboard and click Create Route. The system instantly builds optimized routes for each technician based on location and availability.

🏢

HQ-Based Routing

Routes start and end at your office or warehouse. Optimize for morning pickups of equipment and end-of-day returns. Account for commute time in scheduling.

Powered by Mapbox

We use Mapbox for real-time traffic data, turn-by-turn navigation, and accurate drive time calculations. The same mapping technology used by companies like Uber, DoorDash, and Instacart.

Technicians Get Their Route on Their Phone

Once you approve routes, technicians receive their daily schedule on their mobile app. Each stop shows customer info, job details, and turn-by-turn navigation to get there.

They can see their full day at a glance - where they are going, when they need to be there, and how long each job should take. No more calling the office asking for directions.

Mobile Features:

  • ✓Turn-by-turn navigation to each stop
  • ✓Customer contact info and property notes
  • ✓One-tap to call or text customer
  • ✓Mark jobs complete and move to next stop
  • ✓Works offline - routes download for the day
